name: Blades of Mirage
description:
About This Game

Shape Your Combat Path

As Mira, your survival relies on total weapon mastery. Combine distinct weapon classes to create unique combos and customize your loadout with powerful runes. Master precise skill execution, calculated timing, and absolute commitment to every strike and dodge.

Discover the World of Legends

Journey through stylized landscapes inspired by Southeast Asian archipelagos and mythologies. Carve your way through lush jungles, winding rivers, dark caves, and active volcanoes as you try to find ancient ruins that hold sacred relics and the secrets of forgotten tribes.

Confront the Corrupted Guardians

Every boss encounter is a punishing test of skill and resilience. Face mythical legends guarding sacred relics, where a single misstep can prove fatal. Learn their attacks and adapt your playstyle to counter them. Your victory comes from calculated timing and strategic use of your chosen runes and skills.
short_desc: Face mythical legends in a Southeast Asia-inspired world action-adventure soulslike. Build your playstyle through combination of weapon and runes, choose your best experience then explore ancient realm of brightlands, confront corrupted guardians, and solve intricate puzzles to uncover the truth
